h: Moshe Hands Yehoshua the Power to Plant Torah in the Heart

p: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כׇּל דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת
and spoke all the words of this song
in the ears of the people,
הוּא וְהוֹשֵׁעַ בִּן נוּן (דְּבָרִים לב, מד)
וְנֶאֱמַר לְהַלָּן וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה (שָׁם לא, א)
and it says there, 'And Moshe went' (Devarim 31:1).
It is impossible to say 'And Moshe came,'
since it has already said 'And Moshe went';
and it is impossible to say 'And Moshe went,'
since it has already said 'And Moshe came.'
and the authority was given into another's hand."
It is lengthy and repetitive in its question,
Even though it wrote in Parshas Vayeilech,
and stood in the Tent of Meeting" (Devarim 31:14),
here to write "And Moshe came," etc.;
that it was all on one occasion?
the authority was given into another's hand,
as written there in the Sifrei (Vayeilech):
that he raised him from the ground," etc.
But there in the parshah it is written:
"and stand in the Tent of Meeting, and I will command him";
וְאַחַר כָּךְ וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ וְגוֹמֵר
and afterward, "And Moshe and Yehoshua went," etc.;
and this is from the mouth of Hashem Yisbarach;
and this is what is said, "and I will command him."
that all this is one continuous sequence.
And this is why the Sifrei was exact about the change,
But the matter of "And Moshe went"
that a person should choose for himself?",
that it is the path to come to straighten the heart
"and spoke," etc., "in the ears of the people,"
"This teaches that he implanted them in their ears."
And it is written, "And Moshe and Yehoshua went" (singular verb),
and it does not write "they went";
and likewise here it is written,
and does not write "they went," "they came";
for this was the power of Moshe,
the going and likewise the coming,
so that he could teach Yisrael
the root of the Oral Torah
pertaining to the root of his soul;
and there shone into him the going,
and likewise the speaking in the ears of the people.
וּמִשּׁוּם הָכֵי כְּתִיב הַכֹּל לְשׁוֹן יָחִיד
And therefore it writes all of it in the singular.
And on what is said here, "came,"
אָמַר שֶׁכָּאן כְּבָר בָּא דְּיָיתִיקֵי שֶׁלּוֹ
it says that here his testament had already come,
it is stated in the Sifrei (Sifrei Devarim 305)
that Yehoshua would recite a blessing:
"in the name of Him Who gave the Torah to Yisrael
וַיְדַבֵּר אֶת כׇּל דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת
"and he spoke all the words of this song
in the ears of the people, he and Hoshea," etc.
And it is already written in Parshas Vayeilech:
"and taught it to the children of Yisrael."
But here he handed it to Yehoshua,
spoke the words of this song
in the ears of the people.
And this is why it says "this song":
that it be plain to the eye,
שֶׁמּוֹרֶה עַל שׁוֹרֶשׁ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
which indicates the root of the Oral Torah.
And nevertheless it wrote "and he spoke,"
for Moshe Rabbeinu handed over the song,
that is included in the Written Torah.
And of this it is said, "this song":
who spoke with him in the ears of the people,
to implant it in their ears,
and be fixed in the heart forever.
And this is what it says in the Sifrei (Sifrei Devarim 334),
that his testament had already been given,
and the authority given into another's hand:
that it was given to Yehoshua

Yehoshua Receives Moshe’s Power to Teach

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 31:14 — “ויאמר יהוה אל משה הן קרבו ימיך למות קרא את יהושע והתיצבו באהל מועד ואצונו וילך משה ויהושע ויתיצבו באהל מועד” — “GOD said to Moses: The time is drawing near for you to die. Call Joshua and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may instruct him. Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.”
